rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of teṣu and eka; locative plural pronoun with numeral/adjective
bahuvrīhi or descriptive compound indicating extent equal to a kūṭa
locative adverbial form indicating central position
compound describing something stretched out like a koṣṭha (cell/chamber)

items.question: Which pair of structures occupies the central position among those specified divisions?
premises: The verse refers to a group previously specified as teṣu.
One element is characterized by the width of a kūṭa.
A pair is described as extending like a chamber in the middle.
items.inference: Among those divisions, a pair with kūṭa-width and chamber-like extension is placed in the middle.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referents of kūṭa and koṣṭha in this context are not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Among those, in the middle, there is one pair having the width of a kūṭa and extending like a chamber.
